cache-mode.description: The cache access of the jobs: read, write, write-only or none.

basis.quote: The accepted values are `read`, `write`, `write-only`, and `none`, with the same meanings as the top-level key.

basis.observed: bogus, WRITE, null and an expression reading github were rejected as workflow file issues; ${{ 'none' }} was taken, and Set up job logged Cache mode: none

basis.quote: Setting `cache-mode` at the top level applies to every job in the workflow, unless a job overrides it with [`jobs.<job_id>.cache-mode`](#jobsjob_idcache-mode).

basis.observed: a workflow with cache-mode: read at the top level ran

basis.quote: Use `jobs.<job_id>.cache-mode` to set the level of {% data variables.product.prodname_actions %} cache access for a single job.

basis.observed: a job with cache-mode: write-only ran, and Set up job logged Cache mode: write-only

basis.quote: You can also set `cache-mode` on a job that calls a reusable workflow to limit the cache access granted to the called workflow.

basis.observed: a job with cache-mode: write that calls a reusable workflow ran, and the called job logged Cache mode: write
